summary: Before you know what this repository is
comment:
The graph an agent reads before it knows what this repository is.

**Scope:** phase one of two, and valid with NOTHING installed — no skills, no knowledge graph, no MCP, no beans. One process lives here and only one. Everything else is composed on top of it, and nothing here may import from the layer above.
